g.title: routines
g.text: gco-routines: routine states, the run fault, and handled regions
every routine of a run, the default one included

g.title: start
g.text: admits a background routine (not while paused)

g.title: waiting
g.text: in WAIT, until its targets complete

g.title: suspended
g.text: a background routine at its next command
boundary while the printer is paused

g.title: completed
g.text: result retained until collected or reused

g.title: fault
g.text: every other running or waiting routine is cancelled;
every later command raises "Run is faulted";
in a print, Klipper runs on_error_gcode and the print ends

g.title: owner_err
g.text: the error reaches the owner as an ordinary
G-code error; the run is not faulted

g.title: child_err
g.text: it fails alone; no other routine is cancelled;
the WAIT of a routine waiting on it raises

g.title: cancelled
g.text: cancel, reset, shutdown, or the run's fault

g.title: leaves
g.text: its unfinished routines are cancelled (an in-flight

g.title: retired
g.text: On leaving, failed and cancelled routines are retired
neither a bare WAIT nor the run's final wait waits for them

g.title: absorbed->fault
g.text: no: where gco-routines next sees it

g.title: goes_on
g.text: for example, OpenAMS pauses the print,
